title: YTM solver does not converge for deep-discount bonds
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
Found by Priya Natarajan while testing DuraLens v0.3.

For bonds priced below 60, the Newton-Raphson step overshoots and the solver hits the iteration limit (50) without converging. 7 of the 1,200 Bayview positions are affected.

Proposed fix: fall back to bisection when the Newton step leaves the bracket. Target: v0.4 (Oct 24).

Maria Delgado to supply reference yields for the affected bonds.
